message:
So `mrb_read_int` checks for overflow of `mrb_int`. If `mrb_int` is 64-bit, then we can have values up to `2^63 - 1`. So `H2147483648` would parse fine as `n = 2147483648`, and then `count = (int)n = -2147483648` (negative).

Now let me check what `mrb_int` is in this build:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "typedef.*mrb_int\|MRB_INT64\|MRB_INT32" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/include/mruby.h /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/include/mruby/*.h 2>/dev/null | head -20</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
